motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Tsk... I wanted to impress you for once... (Mutters)

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: Even I miscalculate things once in a while... But it isn't...actually so bad, is it...?

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: You're here to visit me? That makes me quite happy.

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: You got this result mostly thanks to me. Remember that.

motions.name: login
motions.line: So, have you decided what to do today? ...I'm fine with anything.

motions.name: login
motions.line: So, have you decided what to do today? ...I'm fine with anything.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: What is it? I have no interest in meaningless chitchat.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: I'm still busy, so I can only spare you a minute...only one minute, okay?

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Go bother someone else if you don't have work to do. But, don't leave me for too long...

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Hurry up.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Let me help. I don't have much to do anyway.

motions.name: touch_6
motions.line: Here, this year's chocolate... Huh? You thought I'd forgotten? I remember better than you.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Hmph, so it's me in the end, huh?<>Ever since when? ...But I guess it doesn't matter now...<>Very well, let's become closer...and be mine...

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Don't even think about procrastinating, Commander. My eyes will not leave you for even a single moment. Wh-What? Did I say something odd?
